subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should the Microsoft Teams Graph media fallback be enabled automatically for non-personal text/html messages, kept default-off behind a `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` option, or consolidated into one broader attachment repair before either PR lands?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the fix changes Graph call volume, permission expectations, diagnostics, and attachment delivery behavior for existing Teams deployments, and two open PRs currently split the channel and group-chat variants.

options.title: Accept a default-off group-chat fallback
options.body: Land the group-chat opt-in after the runtime scope is correct, while the broader channel URL and reply-shape repair remains with the channel PR.

options.title: Merge the broader automatic channel repair
options.body: Accept the extra non-personal Graph fetch behavior in exchange for attachment recovery without a new config surface.

options.title: Ask for one consolidated PR
options.body: Require one branch to cover channel team IDs, thread replies, group-chat stripped HTML, docs, tests, and live proof before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Accept a default-off group-chat fallback
recommendation.body: Land the group-chat opt-in after the runtime scope is correct, while the broader channel URL and reply-shape repair remains with the channel PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-main history across the Teams plugin boundary and the remaining choice is a product/config compatibility decision.
